source.note: Same kit and recipe as mini-female-b (FBX member with its colour map, all 32 clips with their Kenney names, height 1.1 m: Kenney minis are chibi, the head is about 40 % of the body, so a real adult scale would make the head huge; noon script, faceted shading). He is the bald, full-bearded man of the kit. His outfit is set apart from mini-male-a (red top, brown trousers) and mini-female-b (white top, red trousers) within the noon script: sand top, near-black trousers, brown beard, belt and boots, dark eyes. Kenney's colour map paints his beard, belt and boots with one brown swatch, so they share the hair role; the darker brown under the beard and in the eyes is its own dark role. The FBX rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0. Ground: moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted onto the ground plane by his own probed depths (sit and drive 0.163 m, wheelchair 0.188 m; set their lift to 0 to seat him on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height). His arm stubs stay above the soles, so no clip needs sinkAllowed. The sprint and die clips are authored with real air time.
